sources.title: Sierra hardware overview
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Perlmutter：CPU 與 GPU 分區的問題適配
related.titleEn: Perlmutter: matching problems to CPU and GPU partitions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付核心綁定圖、巢狀執行緒清單及超額配置檢核；1與1.2可重算，交接表包含所有執行緒來源與可用核心依據；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver affinity maps, nested-thread inventory and oversubscription checks. Reproduce 1 and 1.2 with all thread sources and the basis for allowed cores documented. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫輸入初始化、常駐裝置、十次核計算、結果回收；copy60已包含所有必要傳輸；100/140、CPU120/240與k8門檻吻合，版本與回收範圍明確。
related.differenceEn: Draw initialization, device residency, ten kernels and final retrieval; copy 60 includes required transfers. Verify 100/140, CPU = 120/240 and threshold 8 with explicit versions/retrieval scope.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: r個程序各t個執行緒需要r×t個執行槽；超額比為r×t/C，C是被允許的核心數；合成C=40，r=4，t=10；誤改t=12，其餘配置不變；名義式 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio；變更式 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
重用k次的裝置路徑T=copy+k×kernel；一次傳輸可攤薄，但僅限輸入不變；合成copy=60毫秒、kernel=4毫秒，k=10與20；CPU每次12毫秒；名義式 60+10*4 = 100 ms；變更式 60+20*4 = 140 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: r processes with t threads need r×t execution slots; oversubscription is r×t/C for allowed cores C. Teaching C 40, r 4, t 10; compare accidental t 12 with other settings fixed. Nominal 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio; changed 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

A device path reused k times costs T=copy+k×kernel; amortization requires unchanged inputs. Synthetic copy 60 ms, kernel 4 ms, k 10 versus 20; CPU = 12 ms per iteration. Nominal 60+10*4 = 100 ms; changed 60+20*4 = 140 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Roofline：算術強度與可達上限
related.titleEn: Roofline: arithmetic intensity and performance bounds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付核心綁定圖、巢狀執行緒清單及超額配置檢核；1與1.2可重算，交接表包含所有執行緒來源與可用核心依據；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver affinity maps, nested-thread inventory and oversubscription checks. Reproduce 1 and 1.2 with all thread sources and the basis for allowed cores documented. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫水平2000天花板與斜率200頻寬線，標I10交點；另列測量值不可越過模型適用邊界；400/1600及I10交點正確，所有量層級一致並標明上限。
related.differenceEn: Plot 2000 compute ceiling and 200 bandwidth slope with intersection I 10; mark applicability separately from measurements. Verify 400/1600 and I 10 with consistent levels and explicit bound labels.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: r個程序各t個執行緒需要r×t個執行槽；超額比為r×t/C，C是被允許的核心數；合成C=40，r=4，t=10；誤改t=12，其餘配置不變；名義式 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio；變更式 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
Pbound=min(Ppeak,I×B)，I=FLOP/byte；對同一記憶體層級定義B和流量；合成Ppeak=2000GFLOP/s、B=200GB/s，I2對8，十進位單位；名義式 2*200 = 400 GFLOP/s bound；變更式 8*200 = 1600 GFLOP/s bound。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: r processes with t threads need r×t execution slots; oversubscription is r×t/C for allowed cores C. Teaching C 40, r 4, t 10; compare accidental t 12 with other settings fixed. Nominal 4*10/40 = 1 requested/allowed core ratio; changed 4*12/40 = 1.2 requested/allowed core ratio. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Pbound=min(Ppeak, I×B), with I in FLOP/byte and matching memory level for B/traffic. Synthetic Ppeak 2000 GFLOP/s, B 200 GB/s, I 2 versus 8, decimal units. Nominal 2*200 = 400 GFLOP/s bound; changed 8*200 = 1600 GFLOP/s bound. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
